_notes: Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the Store. Write version as TEXT ("1.0"). Notice keys you can add: notice, notice_title, notice_type (info|warning|critical), notice_once, notice_id, notice_start, notice_expires, notice_expires_after_days, notice_days, notice_time_start, notice_time_end, notice_quiet_start, notice_quiet_end, notice_min_version, notice_max_version, notice_url, notice_url_label, notice_url2, notice_url2_label, notice_force_ack, notice_vibrate, notice_auto_dismiss. For extra notices use notice_2_title ... notice_5_title (same key names with _2 to _5 in the middle).
whatsnew: First release of CSR with MK Store - one place to browse, download and update every CSR with MK extension.
